text: Question: Why is my new SIM still showing 'No Service' after 24 hours? Answer: ### Short Answer This can indicate pending KYC verification, a mismatch in submitted documents, or a provisioning delay. Check SIM Services > Activation Status in the app, or contact care with your application/reference number. ### Detailed Explanation This narrows the cause down to three specific possibilities rather than a generic 'still activating' explanation — pending KYC, a document mismatch, or a provisioning delay — and gives a way to distinguish them (the Activation Status screen) before assuming it needs a support call. ### Key Details | Detail | Value | |---|---| | Possible causes | Pending KYC verification; mismatch in submitted documents; provisioning delay | | Where to check | SIM Services > Activation Status | | If unresolved | Contact care with application/reference number | ### Troubleshooting | Symptom | Possible Cause | Diagnostic Check | Recommended Action | |---|---|---|---| | No Service' after 24h, Activation Status shows pending KYC | KYC verification not yet complete | KYC status specifically | Complete or follow up on the KYC verification step | | No Service' after 24h, Activation Status shows a document issue | Mismatch between submitted documents and records | Which document field is flagged | Resubmit or correct the flagged document detail | | No Service' after 24h, Activation Status shows no issue flagged | Provisioning delay on the network side | Application/reference number | Contact care with the application/reference number | ### Escalation
title: Why is my new SIM still showing 'No Service' after 24 hours?
